meta.title: Extend Submission Time is offered on an upcoming RFQ
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the prepared upcoming RFQ summary instead of creating or searching for an event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Open the event's Settings menu on the upcoming RFQ.
Assert that Extend Submission Time is offered and clickable for the RFQ.
Select the offered action to open its time-increase window.
Confirm that selecting the action opens the Increase Event Time window.
Cancel the dialog so no submission-time change is committed.
Confirm the dialog closed after cancellation.
